"""Throwaway probe of the base's public behaviour (not a test; removed before commit)."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

SRC = os.environ["PYTHONPATH"].split(os.pathsep)[0]
REPO = Path(SRC).parent
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w2-13-probe-"))
proj = work / "repo"
proj.mkdir()


def git(*args):
    env = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "HOME": str(work), "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1",
           "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME": "t", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL": "t@example.invalid",
           "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME": "t", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL": "t@example.invalid"}
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(proj), *args], check=True, capture_output=True, env=env)


def write(rel, text):
    p = proj / rel
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


doc = yaml.safe_load((REPO / "governance/project/path-map.yaml").read_text())
doc.pop("decision_register", None)
fields = {"sensitivity": "internal", "permitted_roles": ["engineer"], "retention": "x", "export_policy": "allowed",
          "provenance": "x", "deletion_rebuild": "x", "memory_class": "governance", "embedding_policy": "embedded"}
doc["namespaces"] = {"top": {"paths": ["**"], **fields}}
write("governance/project/path-map.yaml", yaml.safe_dump(doc, sort_keys=False))
shutil.copy2(REPO / "template/.gitleaks.toml", proj / ".gitleaks.toml")
write(".gitignore", ".gov-runtime/\n")
write("notes/a.md", "# Harbour\n\nThe pilot boat waits at the harbour mouth for the evening tide.\n")
write("notes/b.md", "# Kitchen\n\nThe kitchen tide of orders rises at noon.\n")
write("records/dec-0042.md", "---\nid: DEC-0042\ntype: decision\nstatus: ACCEPTED\nstate_class: AUTHORITATIVE\n---\n\n# DEC-0042\n\nThe ferry runs hourly.\n")
git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "x")

env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin:" + str(Path(shutil.which("gitleaks")).parent), "HOME": str(work / "home"),
       "TMPDIR": str(work), "PYTHONPATH": os.environ["PYTHONPATH"] + os.pathsep + str(Path(sys.argv[1])),
       "OLLAMA_HOST": "127.0.0.1:9", "GOV_QUERY_OLLAMA_HOST": "127.0.0.1:9", "LC_ALL": "C.UTF-8"}
(work / "home").mkdir()


def gov(*args):
    done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "gov.cli.main", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
                          cwd=str(work))
    return done.returncode, done.stdout[-3000:], done.stderr[-1500:]


print("REBUILD", gov("rebuild", "--json", "--root", str(proj)))
print("FILES", sorted(p.name for p in (proj / ".gov-runtime").iterdir()))
code = ("import json,sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom gov.retrieval import lexical\n"
        "for q in sys.argv[2:]:\n    print(q, json.dumps(lexical.search(Path(sys.argv[1]), q, refresh=False))[:600])\n")
done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, str(proj), "pilot boat harbour", "harbour pilot", "tide",
                       "DEC-0042", '"', "text:tide", "NEAR(a b)", "a*", "(", ""], capture_output=True, text=True,
                      env=env)
print("SEARCH", done.stdout, done.stderr[-1500:])
print("RETRIEVE", gov("retrieve", "--json", "--root", str(proj), "DEC-9999"))
print("RETRIEVE2", gov("retrieve", "--json", "--root", str(proj), "evening tide pilot"))
print("WORK", work)

Red reasons seen on the base:
  - **S1 (6 red):** a plain-word question gets no hit (phrase match only, W2-M292); the BM25 order fails; the two mirrored field pairs fail because the base orders by path; "QX-4471 gauge reading" gets no hit; the letter-case case finds nothing.

  - **S3 (3 red, all "not a database"):** search raises `DatabaseError`, with and without refresh; `gov retrieve` prints a traceback from `gov.records.queries` (W2-M071).
  - **S4 (5 red):** DEC-9999 is not among the gaps; the base stops with `BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_WITH_GAPS` and 20 unrelated items (W2-M296), on the fixture and on a-dev and b-dev. With `--id`, the bundle carries a continuation and unrelated items.
  - **Guards that pass on the base (37):** the FTS5 table and today's spans; the field pairs whose weighted file sorts first by path; the exact identifier alone; every line holding an exact string; whole tokens; S3's other stores and all FTS5-hostile questions; the model-free lexical latency case on the dev tiers; F1's fixture cases; all of F2.

discoveries: (1) The bundle is assembled in `src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py`, and the traceback on a non-database store comes from `src/gov/records/`. Neither is in the ticket's allowed paths, so S4 and that case can only be met in `src/gov/retrieve/command.py` unless the paths widen (P-W2-13-TD-3). (2) `gov rebuild` takes the machine lock `/tmp/gov-os-rebuild.lock`; without `GOV_REBUILD_LOCK` a test rebuild waits behind real rebuilds. The suite passes the run's lock through. (3) On the base, an empty question returns every line of the corpus. (4) With `--id DEC-9999` and no code tool, the bundle stops with `FACET_UNAVAILABLE` because the closure facet reports "the code index did not answer" (W2-M098).
risks: (a) The suite reads a plain-word question as returning documents that hold only some of its words (BM25 over partial matches). An implementation that requires all words fails the BM25 case. (b) The secrets vocabulary check reads terms through `fts5vocab` on a copy of the store; it handles word, stem and trigram terms. (c) Under `gov accept` on a machine with Ollama and the reranker, the two real-model cases rebuild both dev tiers with the real embedder. On a CPU-only Ollama this may approach `gov accept`'s 1800 s default. (d) The F1 dev case treats the exit run's three expansions as a floor and its `BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_WITH_GAPS` as exact. (e) S4 requires no evidence at all; the fixture deliberately holds a line with "What does … decide?".
lessons: Pass `GOV_REBUILD_LOCK` and a `GOV_SECRETS_CACHE` of the run's own to every child that rebuilds. Mirror a field-weight pair by path so that no tie-break order can pass both halves. The sandbox refused writing to `.gov-runtime/scratch/td/`, so throwaway probes went to the session scratchpad instead.
proposed_decisions: P-W2-13-TD-1 (W2-M098): the stopping reason for an id no record has is `FACET_UNAVAILABLE` without the code tool and `UNRESOLVED_IDS` with it. Options: (a) `UNRESOLVED_IDS` everywhere for an id that no record has and no tracked file holds, with this suite's cases and W1-20's and W1-21's cases asserting it exactly; (b) keep both reasons and re-scope the row; (c) move the closure's part to the ticket that owns `src/gov/closure/**`. Recommend (a), with the closure's part through (c); confidence medium; reversible; it costs one small revision per named case. P-W2-13-TD-2 (W2-M100 against lens G's R8): (a) whole tokens, as the row says (the case stands); (b) substrings through a trigram table, with the row restated and the case reversed; (c) whole tokens for plain words and substrings for a single-identifier question. Recommend (a); confidence medium. P-W2-13-TD-3 (allowed paths): (a) widen by `src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py`; (b) meet S4 and the traceback case in the command; (c) re-scope those cases. Recommend (a); confidence medium; no case depends on which file changes.
